name: ViscElCapMat
description: Material for extended viscoelastic model of contact with capillary parameters.

attributes.name: Capillar
attributes.description: True, if capillar forces need to be added.

attributes.name: CapillarType
attributes.description: Different types of capillar interaction: Willett_numeric, Willett_analytic [Willett2000]_ , Weigert [Weigert1999]_ , Rabinovich [Rabinov2005]_ , Lambert (simplified, corrected Rabinovich model) [Lambert2008]_

attributes.name: Vb
attributes.description: Liquid bridge volume [m^3]

attributes.name: cn
attributes.description: Normal viscous constant. Attention, this parameter cannot be set if tc, en or es is defined!

attributes.name: cs
attributes.description: Shear viscous constant. Attention, this parameter cannot be set if tc, en or es is defined!

attributes.name: dcap
attributes.description: Damping coefficient for the capillary phase [-]

attributes.name: density
attributes.description: Density of the material [kg/m³]

attributes.name: en
attributes.description: Restitution coefficient in normal direction

attributes.name: et
attributes.description: Restitution coefficient in tangential direction

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: Surface tension [N/m]

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal elastic stiffness. Attention, this parameter cannot be set if tc, en or es is defined!

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear elastic stiffness. Attention, this parameter cannot be set if tc, en or es is defined!

attributes.name: lubrication
attributes.description: option to apply lubrication forces when material is defined from young, poisson and en (restitution coefficient).

attributes.name: mR
attributes.description: Rolling resistance, see [Zhou1999536]_.

attributes.name: mRtype
attributes.description: Rolling resistance type, see [Zhou1999536]_. mRtype=1 - equation (3) in [Zhou1999536]_; mRtype=2 - equation (4) in [Zhou1999536]_.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: roughnessScale
attributes.description: if lubrication is activated, roughness scale considered for the particles to evaluate the effective restitution coefficient.

attributes.name: tc
attributes.description: Contact time

attributes.name: theta
attributes.description: Contact angle [°]

attributes.name: viscoDyn
attributes.description: if lubrication is activated, surrounding fluid dynamic viscosity considered to evaluate the effective restitution coefficient as a function of the local Stokes number of the collision.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.
